name: Lechindi Mahila Lokam
description: Centers women's voices in a narrative of empowerment and resistance. The Telugu film weaves together diverse female experiences, examining how women balance societal expectations, personal goals, and systemic obstacles.

name: Leader
description: An ordinary man gets caught in a conflict between the underworld and the police. As tensions rise, he must navigate this dangerous situation while protecting himself and those close to him. The story unfolds as a gripping tale of survival, courage, and resilience in the face of escalating threats.

name: Lockdown
description: A nationwide lockdown traps Anita at home just as her life spirals into uncertainty, forcing her to confront a mysterious challenge she never saw coming.

name: Local Times
description: What happens when four friends try to save a dying newspaper with nothing but blind ambition, street smarts, and each other? Local times is a heartfelt comedy of misadventures, where the real headline is the friendship that keeps them going-even when nothing else does.

name: Lokah Chapter 1 Chandra
description: Extraordinary events unfold when an aimless trio of friends encounter their new neighbour - a mysterious young woman with a haunting past. A darkly comic fantasy thriller set in a modern-day metropolitan city, this is the first instalment of a franchise that introduces a shadow world that exists alongside our own. Starring Kalyani Priyadarshan, Naslen, Chandu, Arun Kurian and Sandy in pivotal roles, Lokah promises an entertaining ride this festive season!

name: Lucky the Superstar
description: A stray puppys adventure transforms lives: helping a child heal, bringing a family together, and causing political mayhem while finding her way home.

name: Love Insurance Kompany
description: In a world where everything can be insured, a company dares to insure love. An app predicts heartbreak and controls relationships through calculated risk. The voice behind it believes love is just data until he feels it himself. When the system flags his own relationship as a failure, it begins pulling them apart. He discovers the app doesn't just predict love, it manipulates it. Now, he must choose between the system the whole world believes in, set in 2040 and the heart and the purest form of love he can't silence.

name: LBW Love Beyond Wicket

name: LipLock

name: Little Hearts
description: Akhil`s failure in the EAMCET exam pushes him into the grind of long-term coaching, where academic pressure and personal heartbreak collide. Struggling to find meaning, he discovers the fine line between shallow attraction and true love. At the coaching centre, he meets Khatyayani, a girl who captures his heart instantly. But when she rejects him for a strange, unexpected reason, Akhil`s life takes a new turn. Refusing to let go, he embarks on a journey filled with humour, heart, and transformation, one that not only tests his resolve to win her over but also reshapes his understanding of love and life itself.

name: Love Marriage
description: Ram, a 33-year-old bachelor from Madurai, faces mounting pressure to get married. Amid cultural expectations and comic misadventures, he embarks on a journey of self-discovery, questioning tradition and seeking his own path to happiness.

name: Lovedale

description: Vasu falls in love with Keerthi at first sight. However, things change when she reveals that her marriage has been arranged with her uncles son, who turns out to be Vasus best friend.

name: Yaaru Potta Kodu
description: In a village trapped by untouchability and superstition, a determined teacher and his students challenge long-standing injustice. Their fight sparks a powerful movement that unites the community and threatens the local oppressor. As hope rises and conflict intensifies, the village stands at a decisive moment where courage must overcome the shadows of the past.

name: Yeman Kattalai
description: Caught between guilt and desperation, Guru`s life spirals after he steals the precious jewels of Kamali, a bride-to-be whose dreams are shattered by his betrayal. Overwhelmed by remorse, Guru chooses to end his own life, only to find himself face-to-face with Yaman in the afterlife. Offered a rare second chance, Guru must right his wrongs and fight to reclaim both honour and love. As fate weaves a new path, Guru embarks on a journey of redemption that leads to an unexpected and heartfelt union.

name: Yamakaathaghi
description: A young girl's spirit lingers at a rural funeral home, unwilling to depart. Her mysterious death sparks an unsettling supernatural investigation.

name: Yolo
description: Shiva finds himself mysteriously wedded to Deekshitha, a stranger. As they seek answers about their unexpected union, they unwittingly stumble into a chilling mystery that defies explanation.

name: Yuva
description: Gangwar in an engineering college escalates into a war.

name: Yegathipathi
description: A portrayal of fishermen in Uttara Kannada, their language, lives and self-esteem. It examines the eroding relationship between police and the public, and the issues that arise when trust in authority declines.

name: Yashoda
description: A pregnant woman named Yashodha, she is advised to follow a few guidelines about her physical and mental well being and safety. However, a set of events occur that make Yashoda live on the edge, risking her well being.

name: Yaaro
description: YAARO is an edge of the seat Horror Psycho Thriller that will have a pattern set against the backdrops of a murder mystery.

name: Yaathisai
description: A periodical fiction based on the 7th-century Pandiyan prince Ranadheeran who ruled during a time when the Chola dynasty lost its power and its people were forced to live in the woods.

name: Yaanai Mugathaan
description: An autorickshaw driver is an ardent devotee of Lord Vinayagar. While he is an extremely religious person, he is unscrupulous in his day-to-day life. One day he finds he can't see his favourite god anymore.

name: Yutha Satham
description: A young woman is murdered right in front of a police station. The inspector at the station suspects her boyfriend, a private detective, who claims he is innocent.

name: Yaaro
description: Yaaro is an edge of the seat Horror Psycho Thriller that will have a pattern set against the backdrops of a murder mystery. The film is produced by TakeOk Productions and directed by Sandeep Sai, featuring Venkat Reddy and Upasana RC in prominent roles.

name: Yosi
description: A student named 'Madhuvan' fears about clearing the NEET Medical Entrance exam due to the mental stress and decides to commit suicide. Luckily, he survives, but gets stuck inside a deep forest which is not at all connected to the ...

name: Yaavarum Vallavare
description: The story spans over the course of 12 hours - from 6 pm to 6 am. The crux of the movie propagates the idea that when a predicament arises, we need not await the arrival of a sole saviour. Instead, common people who rise to the occasion are heroes by themselves.

name: Yaadhum Oore Yaavarum Kelir
description: Punithan has a mysterious charm. He is not a riddle, though he appears to be one. Who is he? Where is he from? Where is he heading to? Why is he here? Answers will arrive only when he breaks his silence.

name: Yenni Thuniga
description: After a heist job by Madhan and gang to rob precious cargo becomes a mess, he is under pressure to deliver the loot to his overlords. Things begin to get complicated when Kathir appears and finally reveals what really happened tha...

name: Yakshee
description: An unknown spirit guards Maya against any possible threats from eve-teasers and Don Juans. But what happens when true love flourishes between Maya and Ashwin Babu, and the spirit isn't all too happy about it?

name: Yaarada Avan
description: The story of the film depicts the individual lives of two young men played by Navdeep and Naveen Chandra. Each of them have their own problems and need money to come out of it. They try different things but fail with each attempt. Loosing no hope, each of them plan a huge robbery and somehow succeed in it. Twist in the tale arises when a drug addict played by Pradeep Machiraju enters their life ...

name: Yaanai
description: PRVs family who lives with his two wives and children in Ramnad district.. Also, there is a family who is convinced that PRV's family only caused the death of his brother. The movie narrates many incidents that happen in the two families.

name: Yaadhumagi Nindraai
description: This is a story that needs to be told to the world. It's the story of several unknown faces hidden in the glamorous world of cinema. It's the voice that screams to be heard. Yaadhumagi ...

name: Yatra
description: Yatra focuses on certain events leading up to YS Rajasekhara Reddy's (YSR) padayatra or journey on foot across Andhra Pradesh in 2003. During the course of the journey YSR learnt about the ...

name: Yaamirukka Bayamey
description: Is a ghost haunting Kiran's ancestral property? Or is it a conman's master moves?

name: Yuddham Sei
description: A common man's ability to defeat the devil. A cop identifies the mystery and solves the problem.

name: Yatchan
description: Two passionate people with dreams swap places accidentally by fate and their common key to get back their lost life is to defeat the antagonist through the girl whom he wants dead since she can foresee the future.

name: Yennamo Yedho
description: Gautam and Nithya become friends. Will the friends turn lovers?

name: Yennai Arindhaal
description: Sathyadev, a sincere police officer, tries to stop an organ trafficking racket. But he is unaware that the man performing the illegal trade is the same person who killed his beloved.

name: Yemaali
description: Malis world is turned upside down when his girlfriend announces her decision to break up with him. Vengeful and embittered, he plots to murder her with the help of his confidant Aravind. Things are about to take a dark turn as the duo get embroiled in their morbid schemes.

name: Yenda Thalaiyila Yenna Vekkala
description: The story of Yenda Thalaiyila Yenna Vekkala revolves a young engineering graduate who is trying to settle down in life. Just as everything seems to be going fine for him, in an unfortunate incident he gets picked up a mystical force for an entertainment play down and is forced to finish certain anonymous tasks or face death.

name: Yagavarayinum Naa Kaakka
description: The hero has some problems with Mudhaliar.

name: Yeman
description: The Machiavellian tactics of politicians in Tamil Nadu form the subject of this dark film.

name: With Love
description: Sathya, wary of arranged matches, agrees to a blind date set up by his sister and meets Monisha, only to discover they once shared the same school as senior and junior. As they bond over memories, old crushes, and unspoken feelings, their journey reconnects them with the past and unexpectedly draws them closer, paving the way for new love.

name: Winner
description: Fed up of Sakthi's hooliganism, his parents send him to the village to stay with his grandparents. There, he falls in love with Neelaveni, who is supposed to marry one of his relatives, Kattadurai.

name: Will
description: Amid a ghost employment scam, a determined daughter races to prove her father

name: White Rose
description: Divya a grieving widow, is determined to rescue her kidnapped daughter. and confronts a psychopathic killer with the help of the police. ACP Vetri, realizing he is connected to Divyas plight, faces a moral dilemma. Can Divya evade the killer and save her daughter? Will Vetri find redemption by aiding her?

name: Wolf
description: Follows two lone wolf fixers who are assigned to the same job.

name: WEB
description: Friends trapped, Veera seeks revenge for sister's death. Torment, fear, and a shocking revelation. Can they escape? Find justice? The answers unfold in their fight against the psychopath

name: Whistle Podu
description: All a full-time bank employee and part-time kabaddi coach wants is to bring national relevance to the school his father built and help young kabaddi players in his village win the national championship. It might prove difficult th...

name: Witness
description: Around deaths that happen due to manual scavenging.

name: Writer
description: Writer is a 2021 Indian Tamil-language action drama film written and directed by debutant Franklin Jacob and produced by Neelam Productions in association with Golden Ratio Films, Little Red Car Films and Jetty Productions

name: Warrant
description: Koattai Karuppusami, a soft-spoken constable struggles for respect in a brutal police force. Pushed to his limit by humiliation and violence, he becomes a feared enforcer, making others question if he still upholds the law or threatens it.

name: War 2
description: Years ago Agent Kabir went rogue. Became India`s greatest villain ever. But this time, as he descends further into the deepest shadows India sends it`s deadliest, most lethal agent after him. A Special Units Officer who is more than Kabir`s equal! Absolutely Nuclear! Agent Vikram. A relentless Terminator driven by his own demons, determined to put a bullet into Kabir`s skull. A brutal Cat versus Rottweiler game begins as the two face off - The entire world is their brutal bloody battleground. The choices ahead of them are impossible. The price to be paid is ultimate. This is a War with spectacular action and heart-wrenching emotion.

name: War
description: War is a high-intensity Bollywood action drama which stars Hrithik Roshan, Tiger Shroff, Vaani Kapoor, among other stars. Directed by Siddharth Anand, War movie is about a special agent Kabir (Hrithik Roshan) who has gone rogue and his student, Khalid (Tiger Shroff) is entrusted to take him down. Vaani Kapoor plays a pivotal role in this epic battle of teacher vs student. Will Khalid be able to stop Kabir? What made Kabir go rogue? Find out in War, the latest action movie hitting theatres in October 2019. Book your tickets now to witness this thriller, `War`. Releasing in Hindi, Tamil, and Telugu in theatres near you!

name: Waack Girls
description: Six girls in Kolkata, India, form a dance group. We follow their adventures as they battle themselves and the world. Waack. Boom. Pow. The two leads are an expert waacker, leader of the group, and their scrappy manager.

name: Wild Wild Punjab
description: Khanne has had a breakup. He's upset, but he has friends like Arore, Jainu and Honey Paaji who encourage him to face this breakup head-on and move on. They embark on a trip across Punjab to help Khanne find the closure he desires.

name: Weapon
description: Agni a YouTuber who is a dedicated environmentalist is searching for a superhuman (Mithran), to shoot and add as content for his channel. The journey is full of twists and turns as he is not the only one searching for him.

name: Waltair Veerayya
description: A fisherman who engages in smuggling accepts a request from a disheveled police officer in order to use it to his personal advantage

name: World Famous Lover
description: An amalgamation of four different love stories: Seenayya and Suvarna, a middle-class couple in a small town; Gautham, a youngster romancing in Paris with Iza, Union Leader Srinu in love with his boss lady, and a first college romance

name: Walter
description: A cop, who sets out to solve the mysterious death of infants in Kumbakonam, realises that a few bigwigs are behind the crime.

name: Wild Dog
description: A Dramatic presentation of the August 2007 Hyderabad bombings and its investigations told through NIA point of view.

name: Whistle
description: Slasher Flick Urban Legend redone in Tamil.

name: Watchman
description: Bala, a lower middle class guy. He is about to get engaged with his girlfriend Anitha the next day. But to make this happen peacefully he must settle his debt of 3 lakhs to Velu.

name: War
description: Hrithik Roshan and Tiger Shroff come together for the biggest action spectacle of Indian cinema.

name: Wagah
description: Wagah is about a love affair which brews between an Indian army officer and a Pakistani girl from across the border. Wagah, the flashpoint border post between arch-rivals India and Pakistan, has been chosen as the film's title.

name: Anaganaga
description: A school teacher uses innovative storytelling methods to help struggling students, overcoming various challenges to achieve his goal.

name: Athiradi
description: An energetic student, Samkutty, revives a banned college festival, igniting a fierce rivalry that transforms celebration into chaos.

name: Aadu 3
description: Aadu 3, the third installment of the popular franchise, is an epic fantasy in which a chaotic twist unleashes a Pandora's box of reincarnations across multiple timelines. What follows is nonstop madness, outrageous twists, and a full-blown comic spectacle.

name: Arjun SO Vyjayanthi
description: In order to protect the people of his village, a man becomes a ruthless vigilante against his police officer mother's wishes.

name: Azhaikkamal Vanthai
description: When Esha suspects her husband Jivan is hiding an affair, she hires a private investigator - only to discover he's secretly created Nyra, a lifelike AI woman. But when Nyra develops a dangerous obsession with Jivan and sees Esha as a threat, the wife must fight to survive against an intelligence designed to outsmart human

name: Aaradhana
description: Maya, a dedicated and pregnant doctor, moves into a rural village with her husband Pradeep, a novelist seeking peace and inspiration for his next book. They hope for a fresh start in a calm and isolated environment.

name: Arivaan
description: Surya, an honest yet hot-tempered cop known for his encounter killings, is transferred to Neyveli following another controversial case. Soon after his arrival, a murder involving a woman named Vinisha shakes the town. As Surya dives into the case, he must navigate between truth and deceit to protect both love and justice.

name: Anthony
description: Anthony is a Tamil movie starring Kayal Vincent, T.J. Bhanu, Arul Dass, Nizhalgal Ravi and Kalaivalari Saga Ramanathas in prominent roles. It is directed by Sukirthan Christhuraja and Jenosan Rajeswar.

name: Ashakal Aayiram
description: Ajeesh Hariharan, known as Junior Prince on social media, is a carefree youngster dreaming of stardom. His ordinary life flips overnight when the shoot of a superstar

name: Aadhi Bhagavan
description: Aadhi Jayam Ravi is a gangster who plans a hoax raid in one of the politicians house to loot him. Meanwhile, Aadhi falls for a waitress, Karishma, Neetu Chandra and takes her home with him. Later when he is attacked at Mumbai airport, it is revealed that she is a part of the gang which is trying to kill Aadhi. The rest is how Aadhi takes his reveng.

name: Alli
description: Janaki leaves her village at dawn to meet her lover and travel to the city. However, when she sees a stranger with her lover, she hesitates to go along with the plan.

name: Aazhi
description: Set in Nagercoil, a devoted father

name: Accused
description: When a celebrated queer doctor in London is accused of sexual misconduct, her life unravels.

name: Anwar Ka Ajab Kissa
description: This a journey of a detective,his life and how things are to him. His life is about following people, finding though he is still in search for himself, how he connects to the people he meets and gets intertwined in their lives.

name: Aspirants
description: It is the story of the journey of three UPSC (public service competitive exams in India) aspirants and their friendship against all odds.

name: Anaganaga Oka Raju
description: Set in the lively town of Gaurapuram, the charming and unpredictable Raju crosses paths with the spirited Charulatha, sparking a fun-filled chain of events. Against the backdrop of a grand wedding, Anaganaga Oka Raju unfolds as a colorful family festival entertainer packed with humor, heart and surprises.

name: Attahasam
description: Twin brothers, Jeeva and Guru, are separated in childhood by tragedy and fate. When their paths cross years later, one a humble driving instructor, the other a feared gangster and their identities collide, setting off a tale of revenge, redemption, and the enduring bond of family.

name: Anantha
description: The journey of Ananta, a notorious troublemaker who undergoes a remarkable transformation into a selfless hero. When a devastating flood threatens his village, Ananta makes the ultimate sacrifice to save his people, proving that redemption can come in the most unexpected ways. Inspired by the powerful story "Randi Pua Ananta" by Byasakabi Fakir Mohan Senapati.
director: Sabyasachi Mohapatra, Kumar C Dev Mohapatra

name: Angammal
description: In a rural Tamil Nadu village in the mid-1990s, a mother and son clash over one woman

name: Anali
description: Set over a single, harrowing night, the story follows Jansi and her eight-year-old child as they are caught amid looming Third World War tensions and hunted by three ruthless men Lal Chetta, Khan Bhai, and Ranga Reddy, more dangerous than wild animals. With survival at stake, Jansi relies solely on her intelligence and resolve to outwit her pursuers and bring the nightmare to an end.

name: Azhagiya Tamil Magan
description: Guru Moorthy Joseph Vijay is an athlete and business management student and suffers from extrasensory perception ESP wherein what he dreams shall come true sooner or later. He is about to get married to Abhinaya Shriya Saran when he dreams that he is stabbing her.To keep her safe, he runs away to Mumbai. However, there he sees his look alike, Prasad Vijay and develops a different interpretation of the dream now. Before he catches Prasad, Prasad has gone to Chennai where he meets Abhinaya and plans to marry her. Abhinaya mistakes him for Guru and brings him home. Meanwhile, Guru comes back and tells the truth. However, no one believes him. But later, the truth prevails followed by a tense battle between the two. In the process, Guru stabs Abhinaya. She is taken to the hospital where again Prasad changes into Gurus clothes and enters her room. Whether the real Guru is able to get his identity back, is what remains to be seen.

name: Aandavan Kattalai
description: Aandavan Kattalai talks about young people who dream of going to foreign countries, and in their desperation, use fake passports and get into trouble.

name: AIR All India Rankers
description: Three students from different backgrounds unite at an elite college, questioning their paths. With help from an unconventional teacher, they challenge the system's rigid expectations while discovering their true identities.

name: Akhanda 2
description: God of Masses Nandamuri Balakrishna, Blockbuster Maker Boyapati Sreenu, Raam Achanta, Gopi Achanta, 14 Reels Plus, M Tejaswini Nandamuri Presents Akhanda 2: Thaandavam

name: Autograph
description: Follow Senthil's life through vignettes of his past presented by the people he visits while distributing his marriage invitations. His love life is the aspect in prime focus -- while we are presented with nuggets of other developm...

name: Aasai
description: A young woman's brother-in-law is infatuated with her and pulls out all the stops to destroy her love affair with another young man.

name: Arjun Chakravarthy
description: Set in 1970s-80s India, Arjun Chakravarthy is a gripping tale of passion, perseverance, and patriotism. Based on the true story of a forgotten kabaddi legend, the film follows Arjun`s rise from village grounds to national glory, overcoming poverty, politics, and personal loss. Blending high-intensity sports action with heartfelt drama, this inspiring film honours a hero who played for pride, not fame.

name: Amala
description: Amala portrays the journey of a brilliant police officer who is entrusted with the task of solving a series of murders happening in the city overnight. He sets out to find clues that would lead him to the killer.

name: Aan Paavam Pollathathu
description: A year into their marriage, unable to distinguish between toxicity and mere misunderstandings, Sakthi decides to part ways with Siva. The story unfolds as the couple navigates their separation, and whether they ultimately proceed with divorce forms the emotional climax. A hilarious face-off between an online feminist and a pseudo-Periyarist, the film offers a witty, heartfelt take on modern relationships, packed with laughter, drama, and emotion.

name: Aaromaley
description: A hopeless romantic, Ajith believes love is movie magic, but his life is a series of misunderstandings. After a fiasco, his parents force him to work at a matrimony agency. There, he clashes with his pragmatic boss, Anjali, who believes love is pure logic. Their dynamic forces Ajith to learn that love must be earned. By the time he understands this truth, love is gone. Years later, destiny offers him one last chance. Will love wait this time?

name: Avihitham
description: In a patriarchal village consumed by rumours of an illicit affair, Avihitham lays bare the absurdities of societal judgement and the relentless scrutiny of a woman`s identity.

name: Aaryan
description: A middle-aged, failed writer stuns everyone when he boldly declares that he is about to commit the perfect crime. What follows is a gripping cat-and-mouse chase as a determined cop and his team race against time to stop a chillingly well-planned series of murders.

name: Accused
description: Accused unfolds as a gripping narrative that goes beyond action, delving into themes of love, betrayal, loyalty, and emotional turmoil. The story revolves around Kanakku, a grounded man living a peaceful life with his sister, close friends, and his beloved Malar. When a sudden tragedy disrupts his world, he is forced onto a dangerous path in search of justice. Along the way, he meets Vendhan, an emotionally scarred man entangled within the system, unaware of the power plays controlling his fate. Together, they navigate a complex web of chaos, leading to an intense and unforgettable climax.

name: Andha 7 Naatkal
description: First telescope-based movie in the Tamil industry. The story is about whether a man can change what even God cannot through the power of his love.

name: Arabia Kadali
description: A suspenseful drama series that follows a group of fishermen from rival villages who unknowingly cross into international waters and are imprisoned in a foreign jail. Their harrowing journey evolves into a powerful saga of resilience, showcasing an unbreakable will to fight for justice. Will the fishermen make it back home? Can the two villages reunite?

name: Aadhavan
description: Aadhavan, a sharpshooter, is hired by Dr Reddy to kill magistrate Subramaniam, who is set to uncover a list of culprits involved in an organ racket.

name: Aviyal
description: Aviyal is a collection of five Tamil short films made by various directors, including Alphonse Puthren, Sameer Sulthan, Lokesh Kanakaraj, Mohit Mehra and Guru Smaran.

name: Andhera
description: In the shadow of Mumbai's shimmering skyline, a sinister force hunts the living. In this visceral tale of urban horror, a fearless cop and a haunted medical student must take on this living darkness to avert impending doom.

name: A Aa E Ee
description: This family comedy is directed by Sabapathy Dhakshinamurthy and stars Prabhu, Navdeep, Arvind, Saranya Mohan, and Monica and revolves around a doting father, his daughter and the man she will marry. The story also involves the daughter`s friend and the blooming of a beautiful love story. V M C Haneefa plays a drunken father, whose dutiful son shines throughout the movie. A Aa E Ee`s score is provided by Vijay Anthony.

name: Anpodu Kanmani
description: Anpodu Kanmani offers a witty and insightful portrayal of a newly married couple navigating societal expectations and traditional values. Starring Arjun Ashokan, this film explores the tension between personal desires and conventional norms with a lighthearted and humorous tone. Blending humour and heart, Anpodu Kanmani invites viewers to reflect on the modern challenges of love, marriage, and cultural tradition in a refreshingly entertaining way.

name: Aap Jaisa Koi
description: Lives of two unique individuals, Shrirenu Tripathi and Madhu Bose. Embark on a journey full of unexpected twists, heartfelt moments and plenty of fun.

name: Akkenam
description: A brave cab driver and a released convict find themselves unlikely allies as they confront a greater evil that threatens to destroy many lives.

name: Ambi
description: Ambi - is a quirky, thrilling entertainer packed with drama, laughs, and twists.

name: Azadi
description: When a pregnant murder suspect is taken to a hospital to deliver her baby, her husband has just 24 hours to execute a daring escape plan. With a small team of insiders, he must navigate armed guards and hospital security to free his wife and newborn. But enemies from their criminal past have infiltrated the hospital with deadly intentions, turning an escape mission into a desperate fight for survival. As the clock ticks down, the truth behind the original murder threatens to destroy everything.

name: Am Aa
description: When Stephen, a road construction supervisor, visits Kavantha, an enigmatic yet beautiful mountainside, he uncovers a series of heart-warming events that shows love in its purest form.

name: Ayyana Mane
description: In a misty mountain estate, three daughters-in-law have died mysteriously. When Jaji marries into the Ayyana Mane family, she faces dark secrets, possible curses, and a deadly threat-supernatural or human.

name: Aravaan
description: Aravaan is a period film and tells the story about the Nayak Dynasty and the Kallar community of Madurai.

name: Alappuzha Gymkhana
description: A 19-year-old battling an identity crisis and tangled love triangles stumbles into the state boxing championship for grace marks. Under Joshuas tough training, Jojo and his misfit classmates transform from rookies to real contenders. As the tournament nears, they face fierce rivals and their own insecurities in this heartwarming sports comedy of laughter, bruises, and self-discovery.

name: Aranmanai 3
description: The ghost of a wronged mother tries to take revenge on a Zamindar and his daughter, but one man stands in its way!

name: Alangu
description: Centres around the clashes between Kerala's political group and Tamil Nadu's tribal youths.

name: Agent
description: A spy with a mysterious past, who is on a mission to uncover the truth about a dangerous terrorist organization.

name: Aindham Vedham
description: Anu embarks on a journey to Varanasi for her mother's last rites. En route, she's entrusted with an ancient relic by a stranger, destined for a Tamil Nadu priest, which may unveil the secrets of the elusive Fifth Veda.

name: Alex Pandian
description: A Chief Minister's daughter is kidnapped for a price. They do not need money , but their demand is worse.

name: Arunachalam
description: The movie revolves around Arunachalam (Rajini), who is the son of the VIP of a village who finds out about his past but destiny has its own play.

name: Antha Naal
description: A film director, his assistants and the cook go for a story discussion in a palatial bungalow. There, they discover footage of a family trapped by an unidentified "maskman."

name: Amaran
description: Amaran is a biopic that follows the personal and professional life of AC awardee Major Mukund Varadarajran who was martyred during action in the Qazipathri Operation of Shopian, on April 25th, 2014.

name: Akkaran
description: Veerapandi is an Ordinary Wrestler Living in Madurai and Has Two Daughters in Which His Second Daughter Priya is Killed by Two Unknowns. How He Takes Revenge on Them in a Different Way is the Rest of the Story

name: Aalan
description: Aalan is a captivating tale that follows the life of a writer who discovers a deep connection to their past life. As they delve into their memories, they unravel a story of heartache, resilience, and the power of love that transcends time.

name: Anjaan
description: Krishna comes to Mumbai in search of his brother Raju Bhai, an underworld don. Through Raju Bhai's gangster friends, his past life is revealed. What happened to Raju Bhai? Will Krishna find him?

name: Aay
description: When a man comes home between covid lockdowns, he connects with old friends and falls for a woman who feels influenced by her caste, while finding love.

name: Aaragan
description: Saravanan and Magizhnila, in love, need money for their next chapter of life. Magizhnila finds a job with a higher salary and moves to a new town, but encounters terrible experiences. What follows next forms the crux of the story.

name: ARM
description: Set in the Northern Kerala in 1900, 1950 and 1990, Three generations of heroes Maniyan, Kunjikelu and Ajayan, try to protect the most important treasure of the Land.

name: Appu VI STD
description: In the Chennai Housing Board, 10-year-old Appu wants to study to fulfill his father`s dream. However, Dharma sees Appu as a threat and tries to kill him. Their clash gets the attention of a gangster Sabaratnam leading to an intense confrontation that alters their lives.

name: Adios Amigo
description: A bustling bus stand becomes the meeting point for two men from opposite ends of the social spectrum. One enjoys the perks of wealth, while the other battles life`s adversities daily. Together, they navigate a path filled with humour, touching moments, and surprising adventures.

name: Ayogya
description: Sidda in his childhood days decides to take on gram panchayat president Bacchegowda, who has been unanimously elected several times. His mother, on the other hand, wants her son to be responsible and get married, but finding a gir...

name: Anarkali
description: The story of a Naval officer who falls in love with the gorgeous daughter of a harsh and disapproving Vice Admiral.

name: Aho Vikramaarka
description: A ruthless cop's world shifts when he uncovers a long-buried mystery,prompting him to battle the villainous Asura and liberate his enslaved victims

name: Adharma Kadhaigal
description: This revenge drama revolves around the intertwined lives of Shiva, Nandhini, Divya, and a cryptic Old Man. The movie belongs to the anthology genre, and it expertly holds together multiple narratives driven by the common theme of revenge. With a well-crafted screenplay and engaging plot, the movie delivers a perfect blend of thrilling, engaging, and entertaining storyline.

name: Andhagan
description: A piano player pretending to be visually-impaired, unwittingly becomes entangled in a number of problems as he witnesses the murder of a former film actor.

name: Antony
description: An emotionally charged mass family entertainer that delves into the profound theme of relationships that run deeper than blood. The story revolves around the enigmatic character, Antony and his close-knit group of friends.

name: Arimapatti Sakthivel
description: Hailing from Arimapatti where only one caste resides, Sakthivel's marriage outside his caste ignites chaos and threats against his loved ones.

name: Arikil Oraal
description: A creative executive at an advertising agency and his girlfriend try to solve the mystery of their friend Icha who seemingly starts to appear at two different places at the same time.

name: Aatadista

name: Naveena Saraswathi Sabatham
description: Lord Shiva crashes a bachelor party in Bangkok.

name: Navarasa Thilagam
description: Navarasa Thilagam is the story of a young man who wants to make it big in the real estate business. How he achieves it is narrated in a hilarious manner.

name: Naanum Rowdy Dhaan
description: A wannabe rowdy who falls for a hearing-impaired girl faces a dilemma when the girl makes a shocking request.

name: Naan Ee
description: A murdered man is reincarnated as a housefly and seeks to avenge his death.

name: Neruppu Da
description: Neruppu Da is Indian Tamil-language action thriller film written and directed by debutant B. Ashok Kumar. Produced by Vikram Prabhu, it stars him in the lead role alongside Nikki Galrani.

name: Naan Aanaiyittal
description: A thriller film directed by Teja, starring Rana Daggubati, Kajal Aggarwal and Catherine Tresa in the lead roles

name: Nannbenda
description: Two friends, Sathya and Siva, decide to beat up a thug as he threatens to kill Sathya's girlfriend Ramya. However, when the thug dies in an accident, the two friends are accused of murdering him.

name: Naanthan Shabana
description: This Spin-off from Baby (2015) provides the back-story of intelligence agent Shabana, and chronicles how she becomes a spy.
